about: LIC1 (hard rule #32). Every third-party item and every icon, glyph, image and font the app uses. Checked by tools/check-licences.mjs (run by tools/probe-data.mjs); THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md is generated from this file (node tools/check-licences.mjs --write).

policy.refused: GPL, AGPL, LGPL, MPL, any share-alike (SA), non-commercial (NC) or no-derivatives (ND) terms; anything else needs the user's decision first
policy.decisions: Q13 (user, 2026-10-14): material licences CC0, CC-BY 4.0 with attribution, SIL OFL, own work, AI-generated pictures (tool and terms recorded); refuse SA, NC, ND.

items.name: MediaPipe Tasks Vision — JavaScript library and its WebAssembly files
items.notes: Hand detection in the browser (src/handdet.js — on the main thread or in our worker src/hand-worker.js, LAT2). Loaded from jsDelivr at start. Vendored with its LICENSE/NOTICE in stage 4 (offline).

items.name: MediaPipe hand landmarker model (float16, version 1)
items.source: Google MediaPipe model card «Hand Tracking (Lite/Full)»; models listed at https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker
items.notes: Licence as stated for the MediaPipe models (Apache-2.0); re-read the model card when the model is vendored (stage 4).

items.name: Vercel Web Analytics — page-view counter of the Vercel deployment
items.decision: Q14 (user, 2026-10-14): keep it and name it in the privacy notice. Cookieless page views only; never sees camera, sound or hand data. Inactive on GitHub Pages (the path does not resolve there). Vercel Hobby forbids commercial use — a paid plan or other hosting before selling (BACKLOG strategy).
items.notes: Script served by Vercel from the same origin; the one-line stub that queues calls before it loads is our own code (src/va-stub.js, outside index.html so the CSP needs no inline script).

items.name: Donation page (PayPal.Me) — a link the person opens
items.notes: Opened only by a tap on the start card; nothing is sent by the app.

items.name: playwright-core — browser automation for the probe runner
items.notes: Developer tool in tools/ only (tools/node_modules is git-ignored); never shipped; no dependencies of its own.

items.name: App icons (home screen / install) — a blue «H» of three rectangles on a light background
items.source: made by Claude Code (Anthropic) in this project, drawn by code as flat rectangles (no font, no traced artwork, no metadata); whether anything was copied is unknown (user, Q13)
items.tool: Claude Code (Anthropic); output owned by the user under Anthropic's commercial terms

items.name: Interface and canvas text — the device's system fonts (CSS --font stack, canvas system-ui)
items.source: style.css --font: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; src/draw.js ctx.font system-ui
items.notes: No font file is shipped; the person's device draws the text with its own fonts.
items.replace: to be replaced by the user's own authored design (a chosen typeface under OFL-1.1 or own work, set through the UI1 design tokens)

items.name: Unicode symbols and emoji used as icons and signs (list below)
items.source: characters in our own text; their pictures come from the device's fonts (Segoe UI Symbol / Segoe UI Emoji on Windows, Apple Color Emoji and SF on Apple devices, Noto on Android) — no file shipped
items.notes: Each device draws them differently. Pictures of them in marketing (screenshots, the promo video) may fall under the font owner's terms — another reason to replace them.
items.replace: to be replaced by the user's own authored design — one icon component / SVG sprite (UI1)

items.name: three.js (3D library) — reference prototype only
items.notes: Loaded only by docs/prototypes/rooms-of-light.html (the strategist's «Rooms of light» prototype — a REFERENCE for Calm, not app code). Not shipped; if Calm adopts it, it is vendored with its LICENSE and becomes a shipped entry (STAGE4-CALM plan).

items.name: three.js (3D library) — the Calm forest room
items.notes: Vendored with its LICENSE (VIS1b, RUN 6): loaded LAZILY from our own origin by src/views/scene/host.js (a dynamic import of the UMD file, which sets globalThis.THREE) only when Calm shows the Forest background — never in Full. No CSP change.
